name: agg
description: agg — asciicast to GIF converter. Convert terminal recordings (asciicast v2) to animated GIFs. Non-interactive.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/asciinema/agg/releases/download/v1.8.1/agg-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && chmod +x agg-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && sudo mv agg-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu /usr/local/bin/agg

commands.description: agg — asciicast to GIF converter. Convert terminal recordings (asciicast v2) to animated GIFs. Non-interactive.
